title: IELS2001 Stemmestyrt assistent
shortDescription: Lokal stemmeassistent for smarthus: ESP32 med I2S-mikrofon strømmer lyd til Node-RED og Whisper, som styrer lys via Home Assistant, uten skytjenester.

en.title: IELS2001 Voice-controlled assistant
en.shortDescription: Local voice assistant for smart homes: an ESP32 with an I2S microphone streams audio to Node-RED and Whisper, which controls lights through Home Assistant, with no cloud services.
